name: Type loaders
description: Six small loading indicators made of text in the current colour: a word typing itself, a speech bubble, rolling letters, a selection, a paragraph and a seconds counter.

props.name: text
props.description: The word that types itself behind a caret, holds, and is deleted again. Its full width is kept so nothing around it moves.

props.name: size
props.description: Line height in pixels. The monospaced text is set at about 0.6 of it.

props.name: label
props.description: Text for screen readers. The loader has role="status"; the visible letters are hidden from them.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The colour is currentColor, water by default. Other span props are passed through.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels. Three dots rise and brighten in turn inside a speech bubble.

props.name: label
props.description: Text for screen readers. The loader has role="status".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The colour is currentColor, water by default. Other span props are passed through.

props.name: text
props.description: The letters that roll up through a window one letter wide. Spaces are skipped.

props.name: size
props.description: Line height in pixels. The letters are set at about 0.6 of it.

props.name: label
props.description: Text for screen readers. The loader has role="status".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The colour is currentColor, water by default. Other span props are passed through.

props.name: text
props.description: A short word. A caret sweeps across it and leaves a selection behind, then the selection closes again.

props.name: size
props.description: Line height in pixels. The word is set at about 0.6 of it.

props.name: label
props.description: Text for screen readers. The loader has role="status".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The colour is currentColor, water by default. Other span props are passed through.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels. A run of light crosses three lines of a paragraph, top to bottom.

props.name: label
props.description: Text for screen readers. The loader has role="status".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The colour is currentColor, water by default. Other span props are passed through.

props.name: size
props.description: Line height in pixels. Two digits count the seconds since it appeared, rolling up as they change, and wrap at 60.

props.description: Text for screen readers. The loader has role="status".
